description: Five diverse prompts designed to elicit short multi-sentence responses for SAE reconstruction testing.

prompts.prompt: Explain why Earth has seasons to a curious twelve-year-old. Respond in exactly two sentences, and make clear why Earth's distance from the Sun is not the main cause.
Explain the difference between correlation and causation using one original everyday example. Keep the response to two sentences.

A Python function defined as `def add_item(item, items=[]): items.append(item); return items` appears to remember values between calls. In two sentences, explain why this happens and give the standard fix.

A small team repeatedly misses deadlines because work starts before responsibilities and dependencies are clear. Give a two-sentence diagnosis and recommend one concrete change to their planning process.
Present the strongest argument for and against congestion pricing in crowded cities, then give a balanced recommendation. Use exactly three concise sentences.
